"""Force the fallback paths (dual_by_lp, phase-1 witness) and validate results."""
import json
import sys
import glob
import importlib.util
import checker

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner", "/app/submission/planner.py")
planner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(planner)

nopt = 0
ninf = 0
bad = 0
for path in sorted(glob.glob("req*.jsonl")):
    for line in open(path):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            req = planner.validate(planner.parse_request(line))
        except planner.Invalid:
            continue
        prob = planner.build_problem(req)
        prob["epoch"] = req["epoch"]
        res = planner._safe_linprog(prob["c"], prob["A_ub"], prob["b_ub"],
                                    prob["A_eq"], prob["b_eq"], (0.0, None),
                                    "highs", {"presolve": True})
        if res is not None and res.status == 0:
            primal = planner.make_primal(prob, res)
            if primal is None:
                continue
            nopt += 1
            dual = planner.dual_by_lp(prob)
            cand = planner.optimal_response(prob, primal, dual)
            errs = checker.check(line, cand["response"])
            if errs:
                bad += 1
                print("duallp FAIL %s: %s (epoch %s)" % (path, "; ".join(errs), req["epoch"]))
        elif res is not None and res.status == 2:
            ninf += 1
            cert = planner.witness_phase_one(prob)
            if cert is None:
                bad += 1
                print("phase1 FAIL %s: returned None (epoch %s)" % (path, req["epoch"]))
                continue
            resp = planner.infeasible_response(req, cert)
            errs = checker.check(line, resp)
            if errs:
                bad += 1
                print("phase1 FAIL %s: %s (epoch %s)" % (path, "; ".join(errs), req["epoch"]))
print("forced fallback: optimal %d / infeasible %d, failures %d" % (nopt, ninf, bad))
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python test_fallback.py 2>&1 | tail -10
